title: Declarative DWG schema and open-source fork-lineage reconciliation
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan-only refinement
scope: Screen the LibreDWG project family for structural DWG/DXF evidence not already represented as a runtime parser
Resolve source ancestry for LibreDWG organization repositories that fork existing peer implementations
Update comparator admission and implementation-readiness rules without adding runtime dependencies or routine validation

method.kind: Read project-owned GitHub repository metadata, README, and schema inventory
method.limitations: The evidence is repository metadata/documentation, not a source-diff audit or runtime test. Kaitai schemas are treated only as hypotheses; ODA v5.4.1 and local sample traces remain authoritative for DWG byte layout. Fork status establishes ancestry, not identical behavior or a usable fork-specific result.

sources.observed: The README says the Kaitai format files were written for the author's CAD::Format::DWG Perl modules and points to local Kaitai Web IDE use for DWG reverse engineering. The repository exposes per-version .ksy schemas; the reviewed page did not establish a released general-purpose DWG reader or semantic qualification.
GitHub explicitly identifies LibreDWG/dxf-rs as forked from ixmilia/dxf-rs. The current source-level delta was not audited.
GitHub explicitly identifies LibreDWG/ACadSharp as forked from DomCR/ACadSharp. The fork's repeated version matrix is not independent implementation evidence.
The LibreDWG organization describes its Assimp repository as a fork of Assimp with DXF patches, so it belongs to the existing Assimp importer lineage rather than adding an independent reader family.

existingOwnersRefined: DWG parser layout investigations may consult pinned Kaitai schemas as hypothesis-only structural aids, subject to ODA and local trace confirmation
Peer comparator admission collapses repositories by confirmed upstream ancestry and requires a pinned source delta for fork-specific claims
assessment.planImpact: Adds an advisory declarative-schema route for version-scoped structural hypotheses and resolves fork ancestry for the LibreDWG dxf-rs, ACadSharp, and Assimp repositories. No new peer runtime, test, dependency, implementation subplan, or support claim is added.

implementationReadyChecks: For a specific unresolved DWG layout, pin the exact Kaitai schema revision and version file; compare against ODA v5.4.1 and a local real-file trace before modifying parser code.

Keep a generated parser regression local to the owning code and assert decoded value, consumed bit/byte boundary, and following-record sentinel; a schema parsing its own grammar is not an independent oracle.
Record upstream family, immutable source revision, and source-level fork delta before assigning a peer result; count common inherited behavior once.
